fullPassage: Different disciplines use various methods of proof to justify their evaluations, but not all methods can be adapted to suit every field. In art criticism, for instance, deduction often fails. Deductive reasoning involves presenting statements to support an opinion, and if everyone agrees with these statements, they should also agree with the conclusion. However, agreement on certain aspects of an artwork does not necessarily bring about a consensus on its overall quality due to art’s subjective nature, rendering deduction not very effective. Induction, which entails drawing inferences based on observations, is slightly more applicable but is not without flaws. For instance, it has been observed that many admired artworks feature the golden ratio, leading to the inference that incorporating the golden ratio elevates an artwork’s aesthetic value. This generalization fails to consider the fact that there are both admired artworks that lack this ratio and unsuccessful works that include it. More likely than not, someone detected the golden ratio in an artwork after noting certain qualities, such as color and composition, that they personally felt made the artwork aesthetically pleasing. Once again, it all boils down to individual perception shaping one’s judgment of art.

② completely inapplicable(전혀 적용 불가능한) — '전혀 안 된다'면 뒤의 '결함이 없지는 않다(즉 어느 정도는 된다)'와 모순돼요.

③ perfectly objective(완전히 객관적인) — 예술은 주관적이라는 글 전체 흐름과 반대예요.

questions.passage: Different disciplines use various methods of proof to justify their evaluations, but not all methods can be adapted to suit every field. In art criticism, for instance, deduction often fails. Deductive reasoning involves presenting statements to support an opinion, and if everyone agrees with these statements, they should also agree with the conclusion. However, agreement on certain aspects of an artwork does not necessarily bring about a consensus on its overall quality due to art’s subjective nature, rendering deduction not very effective. Induction, which entails drawing inferences based on observations, is slightly more applicable but is not without flaws. For instance, it has been observed that many admired artworks feature the golden ratio, leading to the inference that incorporating the golden ratio elevates an artwork’s aesthetic value. This generalization fails to consider the fact that there are both admired artworks that lack this ratio and unsuccessful works that include it. More likely than not, someone detected the golden ratio in an artwork after noting certain qualities, such as color and composition, that they personally felt made the artwork aesthetically pleasing. Once again, it all boils down to individual perception shaping one’s judgment of art.

questions.stem:

[조건] (1) consider, fact, fails, generalization, the, This, to를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '이 일반화는 ~라는 사실을 고려하지 못한다'는 「주어(This generalization) + 동사(fails) + to consider + the fact」 순서로 쓴다.
det.analysis:
먼저 주어 'This generalization(이 일반화)'을 놓아요.
동사는 'fail to+동사원형(~하지 못하다)' 구조라서 fails to consider 순으로 이어요.
마지막으로 '그 사실을'에 해당하는 the fact를 목적어로 붙이면 'This generalization fails to consider the fact'가 완성돼요.
주의: 주어가 단수(generalization)이므로 동사는 fails로 -s를 붙여요.
det.tip: fail to + 동사원형 = ~하지 못하다 / 단수 주어에 fails

det.korean: 앞 절 전체(부분 동의가 전체 합의를 가져오지 못한다)에 이어 '그리하여 연역을 별로 효과적이지 못하게 만들면서'라는 뜻을 더하는 분사구문이므로 render를 현재분사 rendering으로 바꾼다.

render를 그대로 두면 앞 절에 이미 동사(does ... bring)가 있어 한 문장에 동사가 둘이 되어 문법상 성립하지 않아요.

questions.passage: Different disciplines use various methods of proof to justify their evaluations, but not all methods can be adapted to suit every field. In art criticism, for instance, deduction often fails. Deductive reasoning involves presenting statements to support an opinion, and __________. However, agreement on certain aspects of an artwork does not necessarily bring about a consensus on its overall quality due to art’s subjective nature, rendering deduction not very effective. Induction, which entails drawing inferences based on observations, is slightly more applicable but is not without flaws. For instance, it has been observed that many admired artworks feature the golden ratio, leading to the inference that incorporating the golden ratio elevates an artwork’s aesthetic value. This generalization fails to consider the fact that there are both admired artworks that lack this ratio and unsuccessful works that include it. More likely than not, someone detected the golden ratio in an artwork after noting certain qualities, such as color and composition, that they personally felt made the artwork aesthetically pleasing. Once again, it all boils down to individual perception shaping one’s judgment of art.
